tools.name: assess_grant_readiness
tools.description: Assess how prepared a nonprofit is to pursue grant funding. Returns a 0-100 readiness score, readiness tier, category breakdown, risk flags, a prioritized action plan and grant-packet guidance. Does not guarantee eligibility, approval, or funding, and does not provide legal, tax, or financial advice.

inputSchema.description: Grant-readiness answers. Provide either a flat map of field_id -> value, or an object nested by readiness area (org_background, tax_registrations, financials, governance, program_project, policies, supporting_docs). Missing fields score as not-yet-in-place.
